description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
